metadata.purpose: Analysis of .native files in Client/packages/features/ for cross-platform consolidation
metadata.methodology: Categorized by business logic complexity, platform-specific APIs, and consolidation potential

keep_native.description: Must remain platform-specific due to native APIs or fundamental platform differences

consolidation_impact.high: 45 files with 6,250 lines of duplicate business logic
consolidation_impact.medium: 24 files with 2,170 lines of mostly duplicate logic with platform differences
consolidation_impact.utilities: 10 files with pure business logic that should be platform-agnostic

recommendations: Start with high-priority consolidation - extract business logic to shared hooks
Create platform-specific UI wrapper components that use shared logic
Move utility functions to shared packages/utils/ directories
Implement platform adapters for APIs that differ between web and native
Use feature flags for platform-specific behaviors within shared components

architecture_strategy.shared_business_logic: Move all business logic to shared hooks in packages/hooks/
architecture_strategy.platform_ui_wrappers: Create thin platform-specific components that use shared hooks
architecture_strategy.utility_consolidation: Extract pure functions to packages/utils/ organized by domain
architecture_strategy.api_adapters: Create platform adapters for APIs that differ (navigation, file system, etc.)
architecture_strategy.progressive_migration: Start with highest business logic percentage files for maximum impact
